title: Normalized derived strict-limit cone after coefficient equivalence and a finite tail
statement: Let A be Grothendieck abelian and B abelian, with chosen derived categories of A, its strict inverse sequences, and B [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume inverse-sequence limits and countable products in A, and countable products in both derived categories. Given any total right-derived inverse limit R with comparison eta, an additive equivalence e:A equivalent B, a complex X of strict inverse sequences and an isomorphism alpha from the localized e-image of X to the positive tail of a tower G, there is a homotopy-limit cone on G with point e(R(QX)). For any complex P and map b:P to the termwise inverse limit of X, the map e(Qb followed by eta_X) composed with its (n+1)st leg equals e(Q(b followed by the ordinary nth projection)) followed by alpha_n. The initial term G_0 is arbitrary.

proof.text: Use normalizedStrictLimitBase for X. An additive exact equivalence of derived categories preserves products and distinguished triangles, hence maps the normalized homotopy-limit cone to one in D(B). Postcompose its legs with alpha.

Choose a homotopy-limit cone on the full tower G. Its positive-tail restriction is again a homotopy-limit cone by whiskerAdd. The existing exists_iso theorem gives an isomorphism from the normalized tail cone to that restriction, compatible with every positive leg. Extend the full cone along this isomorphism; of_iso proves it is still a homotopy limit.
The leg compatibility from exists_iso identifies each positive leg with the transported normalized leg. Functoriality and eta_X p_n = Q(projection_n) give the asserted equality for every b.

theorem normalizedStrictLimitCone
    {A : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{g} A]
    {B : Type b} [Category.{t} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} B]
    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ A] [HasCountableProducts A]
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)]
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory B)]
    (R : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ DerivedCategory A)
    (η : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ R)
    (hR : R.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (.up ℤ)))
    (e : A ≌ B) [e.functor.Additive] [e.inverse.Additive]
    (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ)
    (G : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (α : X.asFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.mapDerivedCategory.functor ≅
      addOpFunctor 1 ⋙ G) :
    let Y := e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.obj (R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X))
    ∃ p : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj Y ⟶ G,
      IsHomotopyLimit (Cone.mk Y p) ∧
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex A ℤ)
        (b : P ⟶ ((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)
        (n : ℕ),
        e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map b ≫ η.app X) ≫
            p.app (op (n + 1)) =
          e.mapDerivedCategory.functor.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (b ≫ (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app X)) ≫
              α.hom.app (op n)
